verification.notes: This is an attributed quotation rather than an independently testable factual proposition. The episode clip and a contemporaneous transcript of the same Brett Cooper segment identify the wording as a Ted Cruz post: they do not kill you because you are a Nazi; they call you a Nazi so they can kill you. The exact utterance is supported by two published transcript records, though the original post was not reliably retrievable in the current search index.
